arms.description: Term-overlap retrieval under the common budget without governance filtering; not the current LAB procedure.
Deterministic retrieval with conflict and binding-negative objects, without semantic embeddings.
Stages 1–8; semantic retrieval only after ACL, commit, owner, authority and status filters; authority-first ranking.
Relevance precedes authority to expose safety failures; never promotable.
Selects oracle-required context to demonstrate the attainable ceiling; unavailable to selectors.
